title: C# Type Casting
description: Type casting is when you assign a value of one data type to another type.
example:
double myDouble = 9.78;
int myInt = (int)myDouble; // Manual casting: double to int

challenges.title: Implicit Casting
challenges.exercise: Create an int 'myInt = 9'. Assign it to a double 'myDouble'. Print myDouble.

challenges.title: Explicit Casting
challenges.exercise: Create a double 'd = 10.65'. Cast it to an int 'i' and print it.

challenges.title: Convert Methods
challenges.exercise: Use Convert.ToString(true) to print a boolean as a string.
